name: Lightbox
summary: Canonical modal image viewer with stable dialog naming, synchronized image/caption/status, finite or looping navigation, direct swipe, bounded zoom/pan, fallback media, focus containment, dismissal, RTL, and reduced-motion behavior.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Modal Overlay composition root that owns backdrop and visibility state.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Figure containing the current image, counter, and optional figcaption.

anatomy.name: viewport
anatomy.description: Clipped gesture surface that contains bounded image zoom and pan.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Stable dialog title independent of the current image caption.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Canonical Close Button that dismisses the modal viewer.

anatomy.name: nav
anatomy.description: Canonical round Icon Button for previous or next image navigation.

anatomy.name: zoom
anatomy.description: Named canonical Icon Button group for zoom out, reset, and zoom in.

anatomy.name: fallback
anatomy.description: Named fallback presented when the current media asset cannot render.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible overlay state controlled by lightbox--open.

states.name: navDisabled
states.description: Finite collection boundary on previous or next navigation.

states.name: mediaError
states.description: Current media failed while the modal and its navigation remain operable.

states.name: zoomed
states.description: Image is above 1x and accepts bounded direct panning.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The lightbox shares Modal Overlay visibility through aria-hidden=false while lightbox--open remains the public compatibility modifier.

behavior.name: modalSemantics
behavior.description: The lightbox inherits modal dialog semantics, uses a stable title, and optionally describes itself with the current visible figcaption.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Focus should move into the lightbox on open, remain contained while open, and return to the invoking element on close.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The lightbox should close on Escape, explicit close, or documented backdrop interaction.

behavior.name: galleryNavigation
behavior.description: Logical previous/next controls, direct horizontal swipe, and direction-aware arrow keys update image, counter, caption, alt text, current id, and polite status together.

behavior.name: finiteOrLoop
behavior.description: Finite mode disables navigation at real bounds; loop wraps logical state without cloning images or focusable controls.

behavior.name: boundedZoomPan
behavior.description: Explicit controls and keyboard shortcuts constrain zoom from 1x to 3x; direct pan is clamped and changing image or closing resets the transform.

behavior.name: mediaFallback
behavior.description: A failed image maps to an equivalent named fallback without closing the viewer or losing navigation.

behavior.name: motionAndContrast
behavior.description: Reduced motion removes overlay transition; forced colors replaces the fixed media scrim/control palette with system colors.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls whether the lightbox overlay is visible; focus management and dismissal remain target behavior.

properties.name: loop
properties.description: Wraps previous/next, arrow keys, and swipe at collection bounds without cloning images.

properties.name: alt
properties.description: Accessible alternative text for the displayed image.

properties.name: caption
properties.description: Optional visible caption synchronized with the displayed image.

accessibility: Use a stable dialog title, trap focus inside the lightbox while open, and restore focus to the invoking element on close.
Close on Escape, documented backdrop interaction, or the visible canonical Close Button.
Provide descriptive alt text for every image.
Keep image, alt text, counter, figcaption, and polite status synchronized when navigating images.
Disable previous and next at finite bounds or wrap all navigation consistently when loop is true; interpret arrows and swipe in logical RTL direction.
Expose named zoom controls, keep keyboard shortcuts supplementary, constrain zoom and pan, and reset the transform on image change and close.
Keep the modal operable when media fails by providing a named fallback.
Respect reduced motion and forced-colors preferences.

web.notes: Presentation composes Modal, Close Button, and Icon Button; shared controlled renderer and opt-in Product Gallery enhancement implement focus lifecycle, finite/loop navigation, swipe, bounded zoom/pan, synchronized media text, and fallback state.

shopify.notes: Product Gallery Liquid composes canonical Lightbox over its image subset with stable-id synchronization, focus lifecycle, finite/loop navigation, swipe, bounded zoom/pan, and localized controls.

react.notes: Shared LightboxArtwork composes ModalArtwork and is used by standalone Lightbox Studio and Product Gallery.
